# Keyboard layout (`keyboard.layout`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Network & devices · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Switches the keyboard layout (input language) of the active app and the default for new apps.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | text | yes |  | A language tag (tr-TR, en-US, de-DE) or a keyboard layout id (0000041F). Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: keyboard.layout
    layout: en-US
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted.

## Notes

The layout must be installed (Settings > Time & language > Language & region).
